newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Swiss Movenpick mulls Israel venture.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Movenpick mulls Israel venture.

text.p: Swiss restaurant and hotel owner Moevenpick is looking into the possibility of setting up an ice-cream factory in Israel, the Ministry of Industry and Trade said on Monday.

At a meeting with Minister of Industry and Trade Natan Sharansky, senior officials of the company said they also plan to set up 12 restaurants in Israel and are in negotiations to run hotels at major tourist sites.
The ice-cream factory would be set up as a joint venture with a local producer, the officials said. The ministry said it would help the Swiss company find a suitable partner.

The Swiss officials said the company's investment plans for Israel had not been affected by recent violence between Israelis and Palestinians and the company planned to increase its activities in Israel in view of the expected growth in tourism in the region in coming years.
Sharansky also met BankAmerica Corp vice chairman Martin Stein who said the bank was checking out possibilities of cooperation with local banks.
